nodes.label: ADR-002: JWT Session Management with Redis Revocation
nodes.rationale: Stateless JWTs can't support instant single-logout, logout-all-devices, or admin-initiated session kill. Two-layer Redis-backed revocation chosen over MySQL blocklist or short-expiry+refresh tokens: (1) per-token JTI revocation (`jti:{jti} -> revoked`, TTL = remaining token life) for single logout; (2) `session_version:user:{id}` counter for O(1) bulk logout-all/password-change/admin-suspend invalidation. Trade-off: adds ~1ms latency per request (two Redis reads); if Redis is down and REDIS_FEATURE_SESSIONS=false, revocation is bypassed as an accepted degradation. Separate JWT secrets (JWT_SECRET vs ADMIN_JWT_SECRET) make user and admin tokens mutually unusable.
